name: scanserver
description: A lightweight Rust web server and Tailwind UI for SANE scanners.

scripts.build: npm run --prefix app-ui build && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path rust-server/Cargo.toml && node build.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:modules && npm run clean:debian && npm run clean:jekyll
scripts.util:jekyll-serve: bundle config set --local path ~/.gem && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll serve

author: amusfq
